# Upload packages 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```
# Read mercier data (1Mb ,female and male crossovers)
```{r}
female <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/crossover_data_mercier/4314_ABCDEF.final.snp.ABEF.phase_v9.2.7.refinedCOs.hap.female.COs_freq_rand_chr.fl3.w1000s50.txt")
male <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/crossover_data_mercier/4314_ABCDEF.final.snp.ABEF.phase_v9.2.7.refinedCOs.hap.male.COs_freq_rand_chr.fl3.w1000s50.txt")
## Get average crossover 1Mbp (join)
female_and_male <- inner_join(female,male, by=c("V1", "V3", "V4"), suffix=c("_female", "_male"))
## Get 1Mbp windows (since 50kb step * 20 = 1Mb)
library(dplyr)
non_overlapping <- female_and_male %>%
  group_by(V1) %>%
  dplyr::slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) %>%
  ungroup()
non_overlapping
# Get average crossovers
non_overlapping <- non_overlapping %>% 
  group_by(V1, V3, V4) %>% 
  mutate(avg_co = mean(c(V6_female, V6_male))) %>%
  ungroup()
```
## Plot average crossovers 
```{r}
### Write as an output crossovers 
non_overlapping <- non_overlapping %>% dplyr::select(V1,V3,V4,avg_co)
colnames(non_overlapping) <- c("Chr", "start", "end", "avg_co")
non_overlapping$avg_co <-non_overlapping$avg_co*100
#write.table(non_overlapping, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/01_data/crossover_data_mercier/female_male1mb_non_overlapping_crossovers.csv", sep="\t",quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}
## Plot crossovers 
p <- ggplot(non_overlapping, aes(x = start / 1e6, y = avg_co)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#542788", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 2, na.rm = TRUE, color = "#542788", alpha=0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  facet_wrap(~ Chr, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "CO per Mbp") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) 

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/co_per_mbp_all_chromosomes.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
## CO vs polymorphosm 
```{r}
pi_4fold_thal <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_diversity_thaliana/4fol_sites_thal_27g_tair10_based_1to1_genes_pi_500mbp_250_sliding_windows.txt")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Convert pi windows to GRanges
pi_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = pi_4fold_thal$chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = pi_4fold_thal$window_start,
    end = pi_4fold_thal$window_end
  ),
  avg_pi_window = pi_4fold_thal$avg_pi_window
)

# Convert recombination windows to GRanges
co_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = non_overlapping$Chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = non_overlapping$start,
    end = non_overlapping$end
  ),
  avg_co = non_overlapping$avg_co
)

# Find overlapping windows
hits <- findOverlaps(pi_gr, co_gr)

# Build matched dataframe
pi_co <- data.frame(
  chromosome = as.character(seqnames(pi_gr[queryHits(hits)])),
  window_start = start(pi_gr[queryHits(hits)]),
  window_end = end(pi_gr[queryHits(hits)]),
  avg_pi_window = mcols(pi_gr[queryHits(hits)])$avg_pi_window,
  avg_co = mcols(co_gr[subjectHits(hits)])$avg_co
)

# Optional: remove NA values
pi_co <- pi_co %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_pi_window), !is.na(avg_co))
```


```{r}
model <- lm(avg_pi_window ~ avg_co, data = pi_co)

slope <- coef(model)[["avg_co"]]
intercept <- coef(model)[["(Intercept)"]]
r_value <- cor(pi_co$avg_co, pi_co$avg_pi_window, use = "complete.obs")

slope
intercept
r_value
```
